s: Dine akilat haapiqoman ubo y"a seipim: bizman shebbet hammiqdash haya qayyam hayu okelin happesach besop kol hasseuda, kede sheyyihyeh neekal al hassoba, dehaynu shehappesach yehe gemar kol hassebia, kede sheyyihyu nehenin baakilato vetechasheb lahem, sheakilat kol haqqadashim tzarik lihyot derek chashibut ugedulla, shenneemar "qodshe bene yisrael leka netattim lemoshcha", kelomar ligdulla vachashibut, kederek shehammelakim vehaggedolim okelim:

Veen maptirin achar happesach apiqoman, kelomar shello yihyu niptarin meakilat happesach baapiqoman (perush "apiqoman", kelomar hotziu vehabiu mezonot umaakalim al hashshulchan), dehaynu shelleachar akilat happesach lo yoklu shum min mazon umaakal baolam, shello yaabor taam happesach mippiv al yede taam oto maakal:

Veakshav sheen lanu pesach — tzarik kol echad leekol kezayit [matztza] zeker lappesach millebad hammatztza sheakal leshem akilat matztza. Vetzarik leekol kezayit zeh leachar gemar kol hasseuda kemo happesach, velo yokal acharayv shum maakal kemo achar happesach. Ukezayit zeh niqra "apiqoman". Ulekattechilla tob leekol shene zetim, echad zeker lappesach veechad zeker lammatztza hanneekelet im happesach. Veim qasheh alayv leekol shene kezetim — al kol panim lo yipchot mikkezayit:
Haapiqoman tzarik leoklo bahasibba. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem leinyan diabad, sheim shakach vaakalo belo hasibba — en tzarik lachazor veleekol:

Yesh nohagin littol haapiqoman karuk bemitpachat umeshalshelin oto laachorehem al kitpehem veholekin babbayit ked' ammot veomerim: kak hayu abotenu holekin "misharotam tzerurot besimlotam al shikmam", veachar kak okelin oto. Ubimdinot ellu en nohagin ken, ella motziin oto mittachat hammappa shehitzniuhu sham veokelin oto:

Tzarik lizzaher leekol haapiqoman qodem chatzot layla, kemo happesach shello haya neekal ella ad chatzot. Ulekattechilla tob lehaqdim et atzmo ligmor et hahallel sheachar birkat hammazon qodem chatzot:

Im shakach leekol apiqoman venizkar leachar shennatal mayim acharonim o leachar sheamar "hab lan veniberik", ap al pi shekkebar hissiach dato mehaakila, ukeshennimlak leekol od tzarik hu lebarek beraka rishona al mah sherotzeh leekol kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t, mikkol maqom haapiqoman yokal belo "hammotzi", lepi sheen haapiqoman taluy bedato kelal, shebbeal korcho chayyab leoklo. Lepikak, ap im hissiach dato mehaakila — en bekak kelum, kevan sheen haddabar taluy bedato. Veyizzaher littol yadayv belo beraka qodem akilat haapiqoman, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t:

Veim lo nizkar ad leachar shebberak birkat hammazon qodem shebberak "bore peri haggapen" al hakkos — yittol yadayv (vibarek "al netilat yadayim") vibarek "hammotzi" al haapiqoman, vibarek birkat hammazon veachar kak yebarek "bore peri haggapen" al hakkos. Veim lo nizkar ad leachar shebberak al hakkos — yishtennu veyittol yadayv vibarek "hammotzi" al haapiqoman, veachar kak birkat hammazon belo kos, shello yehe kemosip al minyan hakkosot shettiqqenu chakamim. (Vetob sheyyimzog kos qodem birkat hammazon velo yishtennu miyyad achar birkat hammazon, ella yigmor alayv hahallel vehahaggada veachar kak yishtennu). Veap sheyyesh omerim shekkol birkat hammazon teuna kos lishtoto miyyad achar birkat hammazon, mikkol maqom hare akshav en anu nizharin bekak kol yemot hashshana, veanu mebarekin lipamim birkat hammazon belo kos, lepi sheanu somekin al haomerim shebbirkat hammazon enah teuna kos, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"b:

Veken im nizkar leachar shehitchil ligmor hahallel — yigmor hahallel vehahaggada veyishteh hakkos, veachar kak yittol yadayv veyokal haapiqoman vibarek birkat hammazon belo kos. Umi shemmachamir al atzmo kol yemot hashshana venizhar shello lebarek birkat hammazon belo kos, im nizkar qodem shehizkir et hashshem bachatima shelleachar hahallel (dehaynu "baruk atta Hashem melek mehullal ku'", o "baruk atta Hashem el melek gadol ku'", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"p) — yapsiq bammaqom shennizkar veyittol yadayv veyokal haapiqoman vibarek birkat hammazon al kos zeh, velo yishtennu miyyad leachar birkat hammazon, ella yachazor veyatchil "lo lanu", veyigmor hahallel vehahaggada veyishteh hakkos. Veap al pi sheen osin shette mitzvot al kos echad, mikkol maqom kevan sheakshav nitpashshet hamminhag kehaomerim birkat hammazon enah teuna kos, im ken eno oseh al kos zeh ki im mitzva achat meiqqar haddin, dehaynu gemar hahallel vehahaggada. Abal im lo nizkar ad leachar shehizkir et hashshem shebbachatima — yigmor et hachatima veyishteh hakkos, veachar kak yittol yadayv veyokal haapiqoman vibarek birkat hammazon belo kos, shello lehosip al minyan hakkosot. Veap shehu machamir al atzmo kol yemot hashshana shello lebarek birkat hammazon belo kos, mikkol maqom akshav i epshar lo laasot beinyan acher im lo shello yokal haapiqoman kelal, umutab sheyyanniach zehirato veyinhag kamminhag happashut lebarek birkat hammazon belo kos mimmah shello yokal apiqoman kelal. Shei epshar lo leekol haapiqoman qodem shetiyyat kos rebii, lepi shellehaomerim birkat hammazon enah teuna kos — hare hu oseh issur bemah shemmapsiq harbeh ben gemar hahallel vehahaggada lishtiyyat hakkos baakilat haapiqoman ubirkat hammazon veeno shoteh miyyad leachar chatimat hahallel ketaqqanat chakamim. Vehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon teuna kos — hare hu oseh issur bemah shehu omer b' mitzvot al kos echad, vegam bemah shemmapsiq baakilat haapiqoman ben chatimat hahallel lishtiyyat hakkos shelleachar birkat hammazon (abal birkat hammazon enah chashuba hepseq lehaomerim sheap hi teuna kos, shehare omerim yqnh"z al kos echad). Vegam i epshar lo lachazor velomar gemar hahallel vehahaggada im hachatima achar birkat hammazon al kos, shello yebarek beraka lebattala, dehaynu birkat hachatima, shekkebar amarah paam achat:

Im neebad haapiqoman, im yesh lo matztzat mitzva acheret, ben shelema ben shebura — yokal mimmenna. (Veim en lo od matztzat mitzva — yokal mimmatztza acheret shehi shemura mechimmutz mishsheat qetzira o mishsheat lishatah vaelak. Vekol hammatztzot shellanu hen shemurot mishsheat lisha vaelak ukesherot laapiqoman, sheap sheyyesh lachosh shemma naasu al yede cheresh shoteh veqatan sheen bahen daat lishmor mechimmutz leshem matztzat mitzva, mikkol maqom kol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veim yesh lo g' matztzot mitzva lelel b' — yishbor chatika mehaemtzait veyokal belel a'). (Ayyen siman tn"ch):

Hannohagin linqob chatikat apiqoman velitlotah — en bazeh issur mishshum noqeb beyom tob, lepi sheissur asiyyat neqeb apillu beshabbat eno shayyak bookalin ella beetzim vaabanim umattakot vekayyotze bahem (mishshear debarim hareuyim laasot mehen kelim, ayyen siman shy"d):
